name: SciTeX release (tag -> CI-gated promote -> publish)
description: Tag-driven release. CI runs on the tagged commit and ONLY THEN is develop merged to main (merge commit, never squash); then containment-guarded PyPI publish + GitHub Release. Copy to .github/workflows/pypi-publish-and-github-release-on-tag.yml - the filename is load-bearing for PyPI trusted publishing.
